Name: East Scarp Remastered in Nyapu's Style
Author: PureJJoy
Description:
These are portraits I originally did for my personal use but in the process of making them, decided to shared them with the community ❤️ I hope you enjoy them😊.

These are just images so you need to [b]replace[/b] the portrait folders in "Mods\East Scarp REMASTERED\East Scarp NPCs\assets\Portraits" with the corresponding character folders.

[size=4]Do not[/size] put them in "Mods\East Scarp REMASTERED\East Scarp NPCs\assets\NyapuPortraits", as it will do nothing.

[b]Credits[/b]
Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/nyapu]Nyapu[/url] for their wonderful art and Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat]Lemurkat[/url] for the wonderful update to East Scarp 💕
